title: Open / Here Lies Love

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Join contrasting portraits deliberately because the image relationship can invite interpretation before a viewer reads the title.
strategic_value: The split face can distinguish Here Lies Love while the red frame and Public band connect it to the season.
demonstration: A large male face above and a cropped female face below meet across the red OPEN THE PUBLIC band.
practical_value: Compare a split portrait as the variable content within a fixed institutional frame.
